{{for|other similarly named sword forms|Leopard in High Grass|Leopard's Caress}}
'''Leopard in the Tree''' is a [[sword form]]. It is a stance with the swordsman grasping the hilt of his weapon, waiting on the brink of drawing. [[Jahar Narishma]] assumed this form when [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] first came to [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|7|18}}
